dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I am your Harbinger, Marionette!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? W—Wait, is that what we're going with...?

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Hmph. I'll give you points for boldness, but if you think such a blatant lie will work, you clearly underestimate us Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Who are you? What are you doing here? The cargo crew's supposed to be down by the port.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a... specially appointed researcher under Marionette.

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: A "specially appointed researcher"? Lady Marionette has already reached the pinnacle of both mechanical and kuuvahki research. Why would she need to hire some external researchers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Scientific progress is built on collaboration, I'll have you know.

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Hmm... fair point. I've helped collect quite a few research papers from the Fontaine Research Institute for her myself.

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Since you're an expert in this field, I assume fixing this Landcruiser's malfunction would be quite easy for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Umm... I fear my research focus is more theoretical...

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Ah, I see! Kuuvahki theory is a most profound areas of study — truly impressive! By comparison, repairing a Landcruiser is much more application-oriented. And it is as you say — they are completely different disciplines.

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: That said, Lady Marionette isn't here right now. You could check with Commander Azalea — she might know about any further arrangements.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course, leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You give the Landcruiser a few good whacks. *clang, clang, clang*... rendering it completely immobile.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's... totally broken... What do we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Hmph, I knew something was off about you from the start. A real researcher would never make such outlandish claims. You're clearly an impostor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could say I'm practically her mentor.

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Oh! Speaking of which, I've helped collect quite a few research papers from the Fontaine Research Institute for her myself. She spoke very highly of Dr. Mosso's research findings. Wait... could you possibly be...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough*... Mm-hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—Yeah! Never thought your reputation would reach all the way out here, Dr. Mosso!

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Hmph. And as far as I know, you should be thirty years dead. Well, better late than never!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmph, I'm not playing by Fatui rules.

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Then if you won't follow the rules... Disappear!

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: This is a restricted military area. If you've got nothing else to do here, leave as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, I do — I was hoping for a little sparring match.

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: Sparring? But you said you were an external researcher... Hmph, now that I think about it, I don't recall the Lady ever hiring any researchers... Wait. You're a spy, aren't you? Then, prepare to die!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I got a little lost...

dialogues.speaker: Risto
dialogues.text: You can leave through either the port or the main gate. Commander Azalea runs tight security around here — even you need to follow the rules.
